editorial.description_en: A hard clear night in January. Dark, cool, and just chromatic enough not to be a charcoal.
editorial.description_ja: 冬の澄んだ夜のような、暗い青紫。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.330, C 0.058, h 272.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 寒 (samu, cold) + 星 (hoshi, star), rendaku to -boshi. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Cold Star" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 寒星. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — hoshi-nashi at ΔE00 3.7, fuka-yoi at ΔE00 7.9, shizumi-ao at ΔE00 8.3. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (92°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
